value.title: PRD 009 docs verbs: where a new pij-rs verb must be registered

sections.name: body
sections.value:
PRD 009 (docs in the pij CLI), #348, lane B, 2026-11-25. Shipped s01 (plan 235: `pij agents-start-here`, `pij docs list/get <page>[#heading]`, compiled into pij-rs via crates/cli/src/docs.rs, dispatched in main() before the runtime: no daemon), s02 (plan 239: `just docs-bundle-check`, a harness checks stage after rust; compares each page's compiled-in sources with the files, text byte-for-byte, type docs as parsed JSON), s03 minus pods (plan 246: concepts = skills/pij/references/community/concepts.md bundled; types and types/<type> GENERATED from pij_daemon::community::types, never seed() which reads governance; building-a-role in docs/cli).

Follow-up owed (one PR after #345/#346): pods page (req-05, waits 008 s02) and s04 refusals/first turns naming pages (req-06, waits 007 s02); restore s04 depends_on link to 007-role-start.dd.json#steps/s02.

Gotchas I hit:
- A new pij-rs verb must be added in FIVE places: clap Command (disable_help_flag + trailing args so the shim forwards it), harness/scripts/pij-native-verbs.json, RS_ROUTE_TABLE (+ the community list in generation-routing.test.ts), SKILL.md CLI-verb row, AND the pinned roster in main.rs `clap_exposes_every_ruled_verb`. The last one only fails in a full pij-rs bin test run.
- `ddocs set` stores its argument literally: pass `pm-001`, not `'"pm-001"'`; arrays need --value-json. After any ddocs write, biome format the JSON (write it expanded with tabs first or biome collapses objects), then ddocs build.
- Plan ids: phases must be ph-<4 hex>, open_questions rows need `state`.
- Links to another workstream fail ddocs-check (WARN counts) until that file is on main: keep them as step notes.
- Backup files by basename collide (prds/ and workstreams/ share 009-cli-docs.dd.json).
- pij-tmux control_mode real-tmux tests flake at load >10 even serially; crate unchanged → not the PR (D-F228-1 family). CI rust-test passes.
